verdict.overall: Since Sunday the biggest movers are ZETA (+21.6%), BE (+20.9%), AMAT (+18.7%) and AVGO (+17.5%), and in each case the near-term options flipped from neutral to opposing as prices ran into resistance — confidence in these as calm range trades is falling, not rising. GOOGL, PLTR and the index proxies (SPY, QQQ) look steadier with magnets holding roughly in place, though SPY and QQQ are starting to build opposing pressure too. AMAT's earnings land tomorrow with pricey near-term options, and NVDA reports on 11-17, so both carry extra event risk over the next few weeks.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker - price jumped 9% to 390.84 and the nearest three expiries flipped from neutral to opposing, with resistance building near 400 and support shifting to 350-380. Options stay cheap but trend momentum is fading.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: little changed overall, but the nearest expiry (11-13) flipped neutral to opposing as the 7.5% rally pushed price right up against its 172.5 ceiling. Support further out still holds near 150-180.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: price fell 6.9% and magnets drifted lower across all four expiries, though scores stayed neutral. Earnings land 11-17, and 11-20 options are pricey. Unusually busy options trading today near the nearest magnet, so it may be less reliable right now.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: much weaker - price rocketed 21.6% and every expiry flipped from neutral to opposing, with floors and ceilings all stepping up sharply (ceiling now 40-43). Stock looks overbought and stretched into resistance with no nearby earnings.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: price surged 18.7% and the nearest expiry (11-13) flipped neutral to opposing, floor jumping to 365 and ceiling to 410. Earnings land tomorrow (11-12) and near-term options are pricey, adding real event risk.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: price climbed 17.5% and three of four expiries (11-20 to 12-04) flipped neutral to opposing, floors rising to 300-330 while ceilings sit 350-390. Resistance is building overhead; next earnings aren't until December, outside this window.
tickers.GOOGL: Since Sunday: little changed - price edged up 3% and only the nearest expiry (11-13) flipped neutral to opposing, floor moving to 270. Further-out magnets and ranges (290-330) stayed steady, a fairly calm setup.
tickers.APP: Since Sunday: nearest expiry (11-13) improved, flipping from opposing to neutral as floor jumped to 392.5 and ceiling to 442.5. Further-out expiries (11-20 to 12-04) stay opposing with rising floors and ceilings. Near-term picture looks stronger than further out.
tickers.BE: Since Sunday: price jumped 20.9% and the nearest expiry (11-13) flipped neutral to opposing, floor rising sharply to 190 and ceiling to 220. Other expiries hold floors near 190-200. Strong run looks stretched into resistance; options stay cheap despite the rally.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 3.3% and scores stayed mostly neutral, only 12-04 flipping to opposing. Nearest magnet/floor/ceiling in VUSA terms: £107.91/£106.48/£110.91. Unusually busy options trading today at the nearest magnet, so it may be less reliable short term.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: weaker - price rose 5.2% and three of four expiries (11-13, 11-27, 12-04) flipped from neutral to opposing as resistance builds near 700. Nearest magnet/floor/ceiling in rough ISUS terms (only partly tracks Nasdaq): £77.54/£75.14/£78.57.
